resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: Used for LDA pseudopotential and full-core calculations. Any similarly capable open-source DFT code (e.g., ABINIT, GPAW) is acceptable.

resources.name: QMCPACK (or equivalent open-source quantum Monte Carlo code)

access.notes: Used for VMC/DMC momentum distribution calculations and variance minimisation. Any open-source QMC code capable of Slater-Jastrow wavefunctions with pseudopotentials is acceptable.

resources.name: Troullier-Martins pseudopotential for Li (s and p components, cutoff radius 2.4 a.u.)

access.notes: Available from the SSSP library or the Quantum ESPRESSO pseudopotential repository. An equivalent pseudopotential with similar norm-conserving properties may be used.
Experimental lattice constant 6.60 a.u., atomic positions (0,0,0) in the conventional cubic cell. This is a standard crystallographic input used by all electronic-structure codes.
